|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 2) of the Virtual Modern Alternate Image (ALT) card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[B2 Battle Droid (ALT) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The image is the Players Committee printing of this version ([[:File:V4-D-b2battledroid_ai-2022-01-07.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC printing (card image or errata sheet slip); card-image dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later), slip dates are the errata sheet's PDF date. Every visibly different printing is a separate version, and an errata sheet slip is a version of its own, separate from the card image of the same errata (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded 7 January 2022<ref name="img-Dark8ba25cd">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/b2battledroid_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/8ba25cdb109b5da73d1397712bcc202e4a11ee69 commit 8ba25cd] (7 January 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/b2battledroid_ai.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Lift Tube (Dark)”. Text: “Draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Attrition against opponent is +1 here.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[B2 Battle Droid (ALT) (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 12 December 2022<ref name="img-Dark12d0bca">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/b2battledroid_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/12d0bca60d8b85645ae7a6604003ce24123ce97c commit 12d0bca] (12 December 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/b2battledroid_ai.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' the Players Committee logo (“SWCCG Players Committee”) now prints at bottom right, left of “(AI)”; the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Lift Tube (Dark)”. It is the current image. Text: “Draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Attrition against opponent is +1 here.”
